children: HEXCEL CORP /DE/ reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $496.4M and diluted EPS of $0.5, reflecting higher Commercial Aerospace demand and improved margins versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $496.4M for 3Q 2026, up from $456.2M in the year‑ago quarter (8.8% YoY).
Net income: $38.6M for 3Q 2026, versus $20.6M in the year‑ago quarter (87.4% YoY).
Diluted EPS: $0.50 for 3Q 2026, up from $0.26 in the year‑ago quarter (92.3% YoY).
Revenue growth: Consolidated sales rose roughly 8.8% in the quarter and 8.9% year‑to‑date, driven primarily by stronger Commercial Aerospace demand across widebody and narrowbody platforms.
Channel shift: Commercial Aerospace increased its share of sales while Defense & Space softened, impacted by prior divestitures and weaker launcher activity.
Margin & efficiency: Gross margin improved to 23.3% in Q3 from 21.9% a year earlier, with operating income expansion supported by higher sales leverage.
Operational actions: Management closed or shifted non‑core industrial sites (including the Leicester shutdown), completed prior divestitures and recorded restructuring to align capacity with demand.
R&D & SG&A: Investments rose due to higher employee costs and production qualification activities to support the product and qualification pipeline.
